name: BSP_PlaneFlight_CoreLaw
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_plane_flight, read-only analysis. __thiscall(controller, float step, float, float, int), Ghidra body 007DB680-007DC82A, 1214 instructions. Calls 007D81B0, 007D9C10, the rate law 007DA710 at 007DB6A6 and 007D7C00 over controller+10h/+18h/+3Ch, then the stall and speed block; takes the live control block unit+9E4h at 007DB6C7 and the latched one unit+BB0h at 007DB6DE, and reads tuning+518h Pilot/Landing/WireRope. partial: 007DB760-007DC82A unread. docs/PLANE_FLIGHT.md | Packet cc7_plane_flight_core_law, read-only analysis, body read in full on the free-flight path. ABI corrected: __thiscall(ctl, float step, float a, float b, float* p) - RET 0x10 at 007DC828, and the fifth parameter is a pointer, not a flag (007DD43F PUSH EDX with EDX = LEA [ESP+34h] at the water call site; 007DC3DC MOV ECX,[ESP+68h] then 007DC422 FLD float ptr [ECX]). Caller census by byte-level E8/E9 rel32 plus absolute-dword scan of every mapped section: exactly three E8 sites, 007DC86E (007DC830, ctl+FCh = 0), 007DCD64 (007DCCF0, ctl+FCh = 1) and 007DD48E (007DCDD0, ctl+FCh = 2); no E9, no vtable slot. LIFT, 007DB875-007DB98D: aoa = (|ctl+44h| >= 0.1) ? -ctl+40h/ctl+44h : 0; q = ForwardSpeed/desc+184h StallSpd / tuning+24Ch LevelFlight (1.8) * ctl+9Ch; qq = q<1 ? q*q : 1; dyn+20h (body up) += min(clamp((1+aoa)*qq, -2, 2) * tuning+31Ch AccelCheatMul (1.5), ctl+90h) * 9.81. GRAVITY, 007DB990-007DB9DD: dyn+2Ch (world up) -= AccelCheatMul * 9.81 * InterpolateClamped(0, 1, tuning+264h LostDragTime (5), tuning+268h ExtraGravityMul (1.5), unit+0C3Ch). ctl+90h is >= 3.0 in every state (ctor 99.0f at 007D7F3F, 007DB825 sets 3.0, 007DB86F only increments) and ctl+9Ch is 1.0 with no writer in 007B0000-007F8390, so LEVEL FLIGHT IS EXACTLY airspeed >= 1.8 * StallSpd at zero angle of attack, and the law is self-correcting around it. THRUST goes to dyn+24h via 007D9050, DRAG to dyn+10h via 007D9140, XDrag/YDrag body damping to dyn+4h/8h via 007D92B0 and desc+174h/+170h, the Ceiling force to dyn+2Ch/0Ch. 007D8470 at 007DC6E6 folds the world accumulators into the body ones through ctl+0B0h and integrates. Refutation: docs/PLANE_FLIGHT.md attributes desc+1CCh YawLimitAngle, +1D0h PitchLimitAngle, +1D4h DragPitchRatio and +1DCh AirBrakeDrag to the '007DB680 band'; none of the four is read anywhere in this body. A complete census of every [reg+0x1xx], [reg+0x2xx] and [reg+0x5xx] access in the 1214-instruction listing yields only desc+170h, +174h, +184h, +198h, +1A0h, +1E0h, +1FCh, +508h and unit+100h. coverage: partial - the water arm 007DC426-007DC64A is unread. docs/PLANE_FLIGHT_CORE_LAW.md. | cc7_plane_free_flight_physics re-derived the free-flight path 007DB680-007DBEA8 from the listing; docs/PLANE_FREE_FLIGHT_PHYSICS.md. It is an accumulator pass, not an integrator: 007DB6B6 007D7C00 zeroes six 3-float accumulators at dyn+04h+0Ch*k, each term is added into the accumulator of its own frame, and 007DC6E6 007D8470 folds world into body through ctl+0B0h (PUSH EDX with EDX=ctl+0B0h, reached as [ESP+0x54] in the callee). Lift 007DB875-007DB98D and gravity 007DB990-007DBA2F both carry AccelCheatMul*9.81f, so they cancel exactly once q>=1, i.e. at forward speed 1.8*StallSpd (31.5 m/s for the installed Fighter row); measured net world-up is 0.00000000 at 141.666672 m/s and -8.78 at 20 m/s. REFUTES docs/PLANE_FLIGHT_CORE_LAW.md section 4.7's clause 'dyn[0x10..0x18] += (d*n.x, 0, 0) * (ctl[0x98]-1)': the real term is (n.x*d, d*0.0, n.z*d)*(ctl+98h-1.0). 007DBC03 FMUL double [00D7A258]=0.0 multiplies d, not n.y*d, and 007DBC3B FMUL [ESP+0x38] scales the surviving n.z*d into dyn+18h at 007DBC55.
